compatibility_target.minimum_reason: 1.0.0 introduced the stable ~/.mercury data architecture and Second Brain memory; 1.1.x keeps evolving provider support without changing the core memory boundary.
compatibility_target.upgrade_policy: Track upstream release notes before relying on changed memory, permissions, skills, provider, daemon, or scheduler behavior.

allowed: export approved artifacts into upstream-readable markdown/json bundles
read upstream version and runtime paths
map approved memory candidates into a migration envelope
forbidden: vendor upstream source code into this repository
assume a fixed upstream internal file layout beyond documented runtime paths
write directly into upstream Second Brain SQLite without a migration adapter
treat local Mercury Method Lab artifacts as upstream runtime state
